attr.title: OpenSGolf
attr.desc: OpenSGolf is an open source engine for Sid Meier's SimGolf (2002): design and build a golf course, add buildings, hire staff and keep your golfers happy. It plays with its own free graphics and sound, or with the files of your own copy of SimGolf.
attr.inst: Ready to play with the free graphics. To use the original game, copy your SimGolf folder (the one with Data, Flics and Sounds) to ports/opensgolf/simgolf.
